title: Recent advances in thin film composite (TFC) membrane development: materials and modification methods
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,1059-1085
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW01011F, Critical Review
Ebraheem Abdu Musad Saleh, Abhinav Kumar, Tawfeeq Alghazali, Subbulakshmi Ganesan, Aman Shankhyan, Girish Chandra Sharma, Kandi Satyam Naidu, Masoud Rahbari-Sisakht
Interfacial polymerization in thin-film composite membrane fabrication is a key advancement, enabling high-performance membranes with optimal flux and salt rejection, attracting significant industry attention.
